At the vernissage Christine Strobl-Oman reads from the poetry volume “alles leben”, which includes photographic works by Zlattinger. Further works are on view in the Seeboden municipal office.

name: Wagner reloaded
text_en: Since 2011 the Stadttheater Klagenfurt has staged Richard Wagner with marked intensity, from Der fliegende Holländer to Tristan und Isolde. The Theatergalerie shows four costumes from Wagner’s Walküre and Tristan und Isolde together with their designs, and turns to the work behind the curtain: the theatre’s tailoring and make-up departments, headed by Bettina Breitenecker and Renate Wutte. Stage photographs by Arnold Pöschl accompany the costumes. Curated by Günter Schmidauer, in cooperation with the Stadttheater Klagenfurt, which lent the works. The room also holds Burgis Paier’s permanent installation Das große Welttheater.

name: FRAGIL
text_en: The Kunstverein postWERK devotes its annual exhibition at the Dinzlschloss to fragility, within the theme “schwach • šibko • debole” of the Triennale IV Kärnten 2026. Members and guest artists from Austria, Germany, Slovenia and Iran show painting, photography, installation, literature and performance. According to the organiser the exhibition treats tenderness as a state of attention, not of weakness. The works deal with vulnerability in material and in people, with fragile ecosystems and with a shared future. On the ORF Long Night of Museums on 3 October 2026, Christina Clar and Phil Yaeger performed “Wieso wir uns wiegen”.

name: Schwach.Unperfekt.Ausgefranst.Echt
text_en: On the ground floor of the Europahaus in Klagenfurt, Inés Urach showed the solo exhibition “Schwach.Unperfekt.Ausgefranst.Echt” (weak, imperfect, frayed, real) for the ORF Lange Nacht der Museen 2026. She announced it as a contribution to the Triennale IV Kärnten and its theme “schwach.šibko.debole”. The exhibition set cracks, breaks and frayed edges against the ideal of smooth, flawless surfaces and read them as traces of movement, time and resistance: imperfection not as a lack but as a form of honesty. Urach studied at the Freie Akademie der Bildenden Künste in Klagenfurt; she works abstractly and combines painting with paper and collaged elements. The artist was present for talks and guided tours from 18:00. PERMAPHEMERA recorded the exhibition as a 360° tour, which is being prepared for publication here.

name: DIALOG – ARS CARINTHIA | Kunst & Handwerk
text_en: DIALOG is part of INSIEME, the tenth design experiment of ARS CARINTHIA – Kunst & Handwerk, with which the initiative also marks its 30th anniversary in 2026. At the Stadtgalerie Klagenfurt two positions at a time answer each other in sequence: each pair starts from a freely chosen theme, first conceived for a defined space, real or imagined, and selected craft workshops realise the designs as active co-creators. The pairs are Esther Stocker and Matteo Thun, Sofia Podreka and Boris Podrecca, Laurids and Manfred Ortner, Karsten K. Krebs and HG Esch, Theres Cassini and Eva Schlegel, Sophie Grell and Ursula Klein, and Pepo Pichler and Walter Hösel; Tine Steinthaler works in exchange with an artificial intelligence. Curated by Walter Hösel. An exhibition of ARS CARINTHIA in cooperation with the Stadtgalerie Klagenfurt.

name: BV ART-EX 26
text_en: Announcement. This exhibition has not opened yet. ART-EX is the annual exhibition of the members of the Carinthian branch of the Berufsvereinigung bildender Künstler Österreichs. The 2026 edition opens on Thursday, 5 November 2026 at 18:00 at the BV Galerie Kärnten, Feldkirchner Straße 31, and runs until 24 November 2026. Gallery direction: Margaretha Bauer, vice president of the BV Kärnten. Press: Eva Asaad. Details on the participating artists follow as soon as the invitation is published.

name: kultur.im.puls
text_en: The association kultur.im.puls was founded in 2009 and runs the Galerie im Stiegenhaus in the staircase of the Impuls Center in Seeboden, with a second exhibition space in the stairwell of the Seeboden municipal office. Carolin Meinl has chaired it since 2024; Peter Kleinfercher, owner of the Impuls Center, is its honorary chairman. Besides the exhibitions it organises “Kunst am Abend”, poetry slams, painting Saturdays and an art lending library (Artothek).

name: Volkskino Klagenfurt
text_en: The Volkskino at Kinoplatz 3 in Klagenfurt shows current films, film classics, silent films and original-language versions, and offers screenings for schools. The federal funding list for programme cinemas for 2026 names it as “Alternativkino Klagenfurt, Neues Volkskino”. In 2026 the cinema marks 100 years of the Volkskino.

name: Universität Klagenfurt
text_en: The Universität Klagenfurt was founded in 1970. It has four faculties and 30 institutes, with more than 13,300 students. Its Institute of Instructional and School Development (Institut für Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung) belongs to the Faculty of Cultural and Educational Sciences.

name: bewegung / movimento / gibanje IN kultur
sources: “KünstlerInnen aus Friaul, Slowenien und Kärnten: Trigeniale 26 – Alpenadriatische Harmonie im Stadthaus Klagenfurt”, meinbezirk.at, 18 October 2026
text_en: The Kulturinitiative bewegung / movimento / gibanje IN kultur (short: bewegungINkultur) is based in Klagenfurt and names itself in German, Italian and Slovenian. Since 2015 it has kept up friendly and cultural contacts with artists and organisations in Friuli and Slovenia, above all with the Gruppo artistico culturale Albrecht Dürer in Tavagnacco near Udine, the artists' association DABLO in Goriška Brda and the Circolo Culturale ENDAS in Monfalcone. With them it organises bilateral and trilateral exhibitions in Carinthia, Friuli and the Slovenian Littoral. In Klagenfurt the initiative shows its three-country exhibitions in the Studiogalerie of the Stadthaus, since 2024 under the title Trigeniale. Since 2018 it has run the exhibition series “Kunst in den Hügeln – Umetnost v Brdih – Arte nel Collio” at the Kmetija Moro winery in Vipolže, Goriška Brda, where artists from Carinthia exhibit. It also organises cultural trips to castles, palaces and exhibitions in Friuli and Slovenia. Its contact person and main organiser is Gerhard Lepicnik.

name: Stadttheater Klagenfurt
text_en: The Stadttheater Klagenfurt was built from 1908 to 1910 to designs by the Viennese firm Fellner & Helmer as the Kaiser-Franz-Joseph-Jubiläumstheater, for the 60th jubilee of Emperor Franz Joseph I. It was renovated in the 1960s and again from 1996 to 1998 to designs by Günther Domenig, and it received Nestroy Theatre Prizes in 2003, 2006 and 2011. Its artistic director (Intendant) is Aron Stiehl. Since 2011 the theatre has staged the works of Richard Wagner with marked intensity, from Der fliegende Holländer (2011) to Tristan und Isolde (2025).

name: Climate Fund Klagenfurt
text_en: The Climate Fund Klagenfurt was set up in 2025 as an association within the EU project Climate Funding 4 Cities. It raises money for climate protection and climate adaptation projects in the greater Klagenfurt area; the projects are chosen in regular idea competitions run by the Smart Climate Lab, the city's citizen office for climate matters. In the first round, in spring 2025, a jury selected seven projects, funded with about 32,000 euros.

name: kärnten.museum
text_en: The kärnten.museum is the museum of cultural history and natural science of the State of Carinthia. Its history begins in 1844 with the founding of the Geschichtsverein für Kärnten; the main building, the Rudolfinum at Museumgasse 2 in Klagenfurt, opened on 10 July 1884. After water damage in 2014 and a general renovation from 2020, the museum reopened on 21 November 2022 under the name kärnten.museum, formerly Landesmuseum Kärnten. Its hands-on museum for children and young people, the wissens.wert.welt, visits schools across Carinthia with the kidsmobil.

name: Lebenshilfe Region Knittelfeld
sources: “Willkommen im ‘Ideenreich’ – unserem inklusiven Verkaufslokal mit integrierter Produktionsstätte”, ideenreich-knittelfeld.at
“Knittelfeld: Das ‘Ideenreich’ eröffnete mit Pauken und Trompeten”, meinbezirk.at, 20 March 2025
text_en: The Lebenshilfe Region Knittelfeld began on 3 February 1982 as a parents’ association and today is a non-profit company with its association behind it, chaired by Johann Hubmann. Nearly 100 people work in its workshops, homes and mobile services for people with intellectual disabilities. It is a member of the Lebenshilfe network in Austria. In the shop “Ideenreich” at Hauptplatz 17 it sells products made in its workshops.

name: Kunstverein postWERK
text_en: The Kunstverein postWERK is a non-profit art association based in Villach, founded in 2012 by Dorothee Unkel, its honorary president. Barbara Ambrusch-Rapp has chaired it since January 2020. Members and guest artists show an annual exhibition on a yearly theme, in 2026 “FRAGIL” at the Dinzlschloss in Villach.

name: JUMP DOME Klagenfurt
text_en: JUMP DOME Klagenfurt is a trampoline park of more than 5,000 m² at Magazingasse 14 in Klagenfurt. It opened in May 2021.
